key_insight: Resource-efficient Knapsack QUBO formulations improve optimal-solution success, with a slackless formulation delivering gains of several orders of magnitude in the reported tests.
engineering_relevance: Choosing a better QUBO formulation can reduce auxiliary-variable overhead or penalty strength while improving quantum optimization performance.
method: Derive a smaller penalty constant for the standard formulation.
Reduce the number of slack variables used to encode capacity constraints.
Use an alternative formulation that eliminates slack variables entirely.
evidence_signal: All three approaches increased optimal-solution probabilities in LR-QAOA simulations and on a D-Wave quantum annealer; the slackless method performed best.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish scaling to large instances or an advantage over classical optimization methods.
paper_title: Resource-efficient formulations of the Knapsack problem for quantum computing
